title: Project: Your First Personal Page
prompt: Write a complete HTML page about a topic you care about — a hobby, a place, a pet, anything. Requirements: - Start with `` and use `` with a `lang` attribute. - Include a `` with a `` and a non-empty ``. - In the `<body>`: exactly one `<h1>` with the topic, and at least two `<p>` paragraphs saying something about it. - Your own words — the content is yours; the tests only check the structure.
boilerplate: <!-- Write your page below this line -->

tests.name: has a document type declaration
tests.hint: The very first line of every modern HTML page is <!DOCTYPE html>.

tests.name: has an html element with a lang attribute
tests.hint: Add lang="en" (or your language) to the opening <html> tag — assistive tech uses it.

tests.name: has a head with charset and a title
tests.hint: Inside <head>, add <meta charset="UTF-8" /> and a <title> with real text.

tests.name: body has exactly one h1
tests.hint: One <h1> states the page's main topic; use <h2> for sub-headings later.

tests.name: body has at least two paragraphs
